Investigation of the Department of Public Utilities, on its own motion, instituting a rulemaking pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, § 2, 220 C.M.R. § 2.00 et seq., and Executive Order 562 to amend or rescind 220 C.M.R. §§ 150.00, 250.00, and 271.00.

The following documents are sent to the Office of the Secretary of the Commonwealth: copies of proposed amended regulation 220 CMR 250.00; copies of redline/compare version of proposed and rescinded regulations 220 CMR 150.00, 250.00 and 271.00; copies of Small Business Impact Statements 220 C20 CMR 150.00, 250.00 and 271.00; and Notice of Public Hearing and Request for Comments. By Christopher Henry and Jennifer Bush.
Notice of Rulemaking sent to Local Government Advisory Committee. By Christopher Henry
